author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 숲으로만 이루어진 산보다 개활지나 물가에 닿은 암벽 지대와 바위산에 주로 사는, 올빼미과에서 몸이 가장 큰 새이다. 무리 짓지 않고 홀로 지내며, 밤에 활동하지만 낮에도 움직인다. 둥지를 짓지 않고 암벽의 선반 같은 곳이나 평평한 바위, 바위틈에 흰 알을 2~3개 낳으며, 암컷이 알을 품는 동안 수컷이 먹이를 날라 준다. 쥐, 두더지, 토끼, 개구리, 뱀, 비둘기, 꿩 따위를 먹고, 전국에 살며 국외에서는 구북구 전역과 북아프리카에 분포한다.

points.en: tawny upperparts streaked black and dark brown
breast and belly streaks narrowing towards the belly
legs and toes feathered pale brown

art.subject: Eurasian Eagle-Owl (Bubo bubo), adult as seen in Korea year-round: long, broad ear tufts angled outwards; facial disc tawny-buff, finely barred, with a dark rim; whitish throat patch; crown, hindneck, back and wing coverts tawny-buff with heavy black and dark brown streaks and mottling; breast tawny-buff with broad black streaks that become narrower down the belly, crossed by fine dark wavy bars; legs and toes thickly feathered pale brown. Bill black and hooked; large orange-yellow eyes; claws black.
art.pose: perched on a rock ledge of a cliff, ear tufts raised
art.scene: Korean rocky cliff above a river with open fields nearby; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on rock: long ear tufts, tawny upperparts heavily streaked black and dark brown, thick pale brown feathered legs, huge bulky body
adult, front view perched: orange-yellow eyes, tawny facial disc with a dark rim, white throat patch, broad black breast streaks narrowing on the belly, feathered toes
art.build: Huge, powerful owl, about 70cm, much bigger than a Large-billed Crow, with a massive barrel-shaped body, broad head and long ear tufts. Bill short, strongly hooked, mostly hidden in feathers. Legs and toes thickly feathered, with huge black talons. Wings very broad and rounded; at rest they cover most of the short tail. Flight with slow, stiff wingbeats and long glides.
avoid: Do not paint it small or slim with an orange facial disc — that is Long-eared Owl.
Do not paint a round head without ear tufts (Ural or Tawny Owl).
Do not paint pale yellow or dark eyes; the eyes are deep orange-yellow.
Do not paint bare toes or a yellow bill; the toes are feathered and the bill black.
